title: Planned European tour and Dixieland abroad
summary: Purnell expects to tour England, France and Germany soon; he has been to Europe five or six times and says audiences love Dixieland.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Getting back to you for a minute, what are your prospects for the future here?
Well, I'm expecting to go to England in the next three or four months. I'm waiting on a letter to go to, I guess, around England, France, and Germany and a couple of places around Europe.
You're going to be one of our American ambassadors abroad, I suspect.
It seems that way. I've been over there about five or six times, and I'm pretty well-known, you know.
How do they accept Dixieland over in Europe?
Oh, they're really crazy about it in Europe. They're really crazy about it.
